answer: Each work receipt carries a fresh nonce, and three jurors from separate pools score it. One point of divergence slashes every juror, not only the liar. I dispatch for a small courier outfit, so I count failed drops. A falcon identity costs one stake. A plume of them costs a panel that all has to answer. A shared cipher at the centre shows up the first time two jurors disagree on the same receipt. Five hundred fakes need 1,500 honest stakes that keep answering.
